requirement: The system shall refuse to dispense a prescription when the prescribed medicine has expired in stock.
The system shall compute the patient's payable amount as the retail price of the dispensed items minus the portion covered by their insurance scheme.
The pharmacist enters a prescription; the system validates the dose is within the permitted range for the patient's age and records the prescription for dispensing.
The dispensing pharmacist scans the prescription barcode; the system loads the patient's active prescriptions, checks for recorded allergies and displays them before proceeding.
As a patient, I want to request a repeat prescription for a medicine I already take so that I do not have to visit the pharmacy in person.
As a pharmacy manager, I want to record a stock delivery from the wholesaler so that the new batch and expiry dates are captured and stock levels are updated.
A prescription may only be dispensed within 28 days of being issued; older prescriptions must be rejected for dispensing.
Every dispensing event must be recorded with the patient, the medicine, the batch, the quantity and the dispensing pharmacist for later recall and audit.
The stock batch table shall ensure that expiry date is in the future at creation and that on-hand quantity is never negative.
code:
-- stock batch table for the pharmacy
CREATE TABLE stock_batch (
    batch_id       BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    medicine_code  VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,
    batch_number   VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,
    on_hand        INTEGER     NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    expiry_date    DATE        NOT NULL,
    recalled       BOOLEAN     NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    received_at    TIMESTAMP   NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT batch_medicine_fk FOREIGN KEY (medicine_code) REFERENCES medicine(medicine_code),
    CONSTRAINT batch_unique       UNIQUE (medicine_code, batch_number),
    CONSTRAINT batch_on_hand_nonneg CHECK (on_hand >= 0),
    CONSTRAINT batch_expiry_future_at_creation CHECK (expiry_date > received_at::date)
);

CREATE INDEX batch_expiry_idx ON stock_batch (expiry_date) WHERE on_hand > 0;
hard_negatives:
-- prescription table
CREATE TABLE prescription (
    prescription_id  BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    patient_id       VARCHAR(40)   NOT NULL,
    medicine_code    VARCHAR(40)   NOT NULL,
    dose_mg          NUMERIC(8,2)  NOT NULL,
    frequency        VARCHAR(40)   NOT NULL,
    duration_days    INTEGER       NOT NULL,
    prescriber_id    VARCHAR(40)   NOT NULL,
    issued_on        DATE          NOT NULL,
    status           VARCHAR(20)   NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT prescription_dose_positive CHECK (dose_mg > 0),
    CONSTRAINT prescription_duration_positive CHECK (duration_days > 0),
    CONSTRAINT prescription_status_chk CHECK (status IN ('ISSUED','DISPENSED','CANCELLED','EXPIRED'))
);
-- dispensing event table
CREATE TABLE dispensing_event (
    dispense_id      BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    prescription_id  BIGINT      NOT NULL,
    patient_id       VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,
    medicine_code    VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,
    batch_id         BIGINT      NOT NULL,
    quantity         INTEGER     NOT NULL,
    pharmacist_id    VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,
    dispensed_at     TIMESTAMP   NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT dispense_qty_positive CHECK (quantity > 0)
);

requirement: Only registered pharmacists may dispense controlled drugs; pharmacy assistants must be refused.
The nightly expiry report shall list every stock batch expiring within thirty days, with the medicine, quantity remaining and location.
